name: code-walkthrough
title: Code Walkthrough
description: A readable code window that reveals a small snippet and spotlights one important line.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: Keep the snippet under eight lines, use escaped newline characters, and set focus line to a one-based visible line number.

useWhen: Explain a bounded real code fragment line by line.
avoidWhen: Do not use for full files, long horizontal lines or output that has not been executed.

inputRules.filename: Supply real file name within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.language: Supply real language within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.code: Actual code, at most eight lines and 64 characters per line; do not drop qualifiers or executable lines.
inputRules.focusLine: Use a real in-range integer; a focus index must point to an existing item.

cueBindings.step-1: When narration reaches code 1, move reading focus to this code line. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.

cueBindings.resolve: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real explanation boundary; use a walkthrough for larger code, never silently truncate lines.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults or custom graphics under recipes-only policy.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.

acceptance: Every active declared event changes its actual visible target; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
The final state remains readable without cropped or overlapping important text, with honest source and timing metadata.
Identify the file and language → Follow actual code lines → Restore the whole fragment. Preserve this reading order and the source qualifiers.
Test Chinese content, the minimum and maximum supported item counts, and one rejected overflow or malformed input.
